capabilityMatrix.note: Sprint-4/5 findings from SCOUT-E + live smoke test 2026-07-25

warmCadavers.detail: Lists 119 models in catalog (HTTP 200) but dispatch returns 404 on specific model IDs. Catalog promises V2 models it cannot serve.
Catalog HTTP 200 (37 models, different set than v1) but dispatch returns 401 Unauthorized Ollama Cloud error.
Catalog HTTP 200 (17 models, strong V2 lineup) but dispatch returns 402 Insufficient Credit Balance.
Catalog OK (23 Claude-focused models) but dispatch returns 402. Came back from 503 on 7/24 but still requires credits.
All router keys fail with HTTP 502. Provider completely down.
Returns 401 Insufficient balance on dispatch. Despite name, not actually free.
Catalog returns HTTP 200 but models array empty (Google API format). Dispatch returns zero tokens.
HTTP 200 catalog (61 Mistral-native models) no V2 targets. Dispatch delivers generic greeting, poor for subagent code gen.
Live probe returned 400 No such model @cf/kimi-k2.6 or task. Contradicts SCOUT-E initial report. Model ID not in CF catalog.
HTTP 200 dispatch with reasoning tokens present but content field null, finish_reason=length.
Huge catalog (145 models) but free models timeout or deliver empty content. Paid models require credits.

conditional.detail: HTTP 200 but finish_reason=length. Content truncated — does NOT deliver pong within first 50 tokens. Needs max_tokens >= 100 probe.
Some CF models do reasoning-only at ~1.8s. @cf/kimi-k2.6 proven dead (see WARM_CADAVER). Other CF model IDs may work with non-trivial prompts.
Auto-shard route with HTTP 200, reasoning content but 13.8s RTT. Only thinking tokens for trivial prompts.
Catalog healthy (59 models) but free model laguna-s-2.1-free consistently 429. Rate limit exhausted for free tier.

seasonalStatus.note: Golden-proven in W47 session but not re-verified on 7/25 sprint-4/5 probe. Carrier-golden-ness appears session-specific rather than stable. Flux-state pending re-verification.
